title: Skeletal Mage in Velvet
description: A skeletal figure wearing a glossy black helmet with glowing blue visor stands in an ornate gothic hall. Dressed in a rich red velvet suit with a white skeletal ribcage design, the figure gestures toward a glowing golden egg on the windowsill while purple and green magical smoke swirls around him.
prompt: A skeletal figure in a luxurious red velvet suit with white skeletal ribcage embroidery and black boots stands inside an ornate gothic hall with chandeliers and classical paintings. The figure wears a glossy black futuristic helmet with glowing blue visor and gestures with one hand toward a glowing golden egg floating near an arched window. Swirling purple and green magical smoke emanates from the figure and the egg. Through the large arched window is a dramatic fantasy landscape with purple lavender fields, a red sky with lightning, a waterfall, and a small red-robed figure in a magical portal. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
